name: Proposal and engagement letter
summary: Turns a scoped enquiry into a draft proposal and engagement letter in HubSpot, queues it for approval, and tracks whether the client accepts. Crons read and draft; a person approves every publish.

covered_by.scope-and-fee: skill (writes the scope and fee into the proposal store)

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Create a draft quote in HubSpot for each scoped proposal.

crons.name: status
crons.summary: Read each open quote's status in HubSpot: published, accepted or declined.

crons.name: publish-queue
crons.summary: Queue publishing of each drafted quote for approval (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a draft quote in HubSpot and reads of quote status. Publishing a quote changes the status the client sees, so it is a live operation and waits for a person.

hubspot.covers: draft quote create, quote status read, quote publish (status update)

gaps: Podio is in the kit with operations, but the only call that names it uses it to rank tenders (qualify), not to write proposals. Not built.
Canva is often used for the proposal template and is in the kit, but no Canva page for this job was mapped. Not built.
ChatGPT can be used for drafting replies. It is not a kit platform, so the drafting is the agent skill's job, not a cron's.

HubSpot quote property names (hs_title, hs_expiration_date, hs_quote_amount, hs_status) and status values are not in the vendor spec. They come from settings and must be checked in the live account before any run.
The quote-to-contact association type is not in the vendor spec (AssociationSpec is empty). associationTypeId comes from settings and must be set from the live account.
No intake cron: the vendor pages do not cover how enquiries arrive. The agent writes each scoped proposal into the proposals store.

Sending the proposal to the client, the signing envelope and follow-ups are not in the pages read. No send or follow-up operation is mapped, so this build only publishes, which the client sees as a status change.
Fee-setting rules, engagement letter terms and the choice of scope are judgment steps for the agent skill, not platform steps.
A draft create is not idempotent. If the process stops after HubSpot accepts a create but before the store is written, a rerun can make a second draft quote. Check HubSpot before approving a rerun.
A rejected publish approval leaves the proposal at publish-queued. A person resets it to drafted; the next publish run then queues a new approval under a new key.
The adapter is docs-only until a HubSpot test account proves the create, read and update calls.
